schema.title: Response Demo Storms Api V1 Demo Storms Get

post.description:
Start (or restart) a replay: the clock jumps to the replay start and runs, and every user's
risk level goes back to clear. Balances, plans and the activity feed are untouched; call
/demo/reset first for a completely fresh run.

Jump the clock forward: `{"hours": 6}`, `{"to": "next_advisory"}` or `{"to_risk": "act"}`
(the first moment any user reaches that level; nothing moves if someone is already there).
The clock keeps its running/paused state. Every advisory and alert crossed on the way is
evaluated in order, so the activity feed shows each change at its real replay time.

The "AI offline" toggle. Off: the review and explain answers use the templates. The plan's
numbers come from the rules engine either way, so they stay identical.
